title: HubFixtureExpectationV1
description: 🛂️ One fixture-declared expectation of a hub contract vector: the stage that decides it, whether that stage accepts or rejects it, and the reason code a rejection carries. `🟦️.ts` enforces it against the observed contract-stage outcome.

stage.description: 🚦️ The admission stage that decides the vector.

code.description: 🏷️ The reason code, or the vector's own name when it is accepted.
